# Release 2.4

This release adds offline mode and fixes 12 bugs reported by users.

- Sync now runs every 30 seconds.
- Run `app sync --force` to resync manually.

```bash
app sync --force
```

segments.2: Offline mode arrives in this version, along with fixes for 12 user-reported bugs.
segments.4: To resync by hand, use `app sync --force`.
